name: announcement-bar
title: Announcement bar
description: A plain, light-gray linked announcement strip above the site header.
usage: One short, centered message on a plain light-gray strip above the header (a launch, a referral discount). `SiteHeader` draws it from its `announcement` prop; use it alone above a header of your own.
avoid: A blue or dark announcement band
More than one line of copy on desktop
notes: The current Context.dev announcement is text-only. Use `AnnouncementBar` directly or the `SiteHeader` announcement prop. Do not add a dot animation or another visual layer.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
